chapter.title: OF FALSE EVIDENCE AND OFFENCES AGAINST PUBLIC JUSTICE

heading: Using as true a certificate known to be false.
text: Whoever corruptly uses or attempts to use any such certificate as a true certificate, knowing the same to be false in any material point, shall be punished in the same manner as if he gave false evidence.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
